name: duty-plan
title: On-call duty plan
for_each: select id,name from policies order by code

sections.title: Policy owner and review
sections.sql: select code,name,owner,levels,review_due from policies where id=$1

sections.title: Assigned duty, UTC
sections.sql: select r.name responder,s.level,s.starts_at,s.ends_at,s.verified from slots s join responders r on r.id=s.responder_id where s.policy_id=$1 order by s.starts_at

sections.title: Handover notes
sections.sql: select name,owner,due_at,status,evidence from handovers where policy_id=$1 order by due_at

sections.title: Recorded handover
sections.sql: select code,name,owner,due_at,status,evidence from handovers where id=$1
